name: Scanner
description: WebGL2 background of rippling thin lines with a glowing scan sweep moving across them, chromatic color split, scanlines and grain, reacting to the pointer and to clicks.
contents: Container div filling its parent with a single full-size canvas
Fragment shader drawing wavy line bands, a moving scan sweep, glow, vignette, scanlines and grain
behavior: Line field ripples continuously and a bright sweep travels across it, optionally reversed
Intro wipe reveals the lines over 2 seconds on mount
Pointer over the page bends lines around the cursor, either repelling or attracting
Click inside the area emits an expanding ping ripple, up to 6 at once
Pauses rendering when off screen, tab hidden, or idle
Respects reduced motion by freezing the wave and sweep and disabling pings and intro
editableByProps: Wave speed, sweep speed, width, trail length and reverse direction
Line density, width, ripple, frequency, scale, glow and brightness
Scan direction, color split, vignette, scanlines, grain and opacity
Pointer interaction radius, strength and repel or attract mode, click ping on or off, intro on or off
Light mode for light backgrounds, pixel ratio, className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Raise or lower the number of simultaneous click pings
Change line shape or wave pattern
needsCodeEdit.where: signal function in the FRAGMENT shader

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pointer smoothing or idle pause timing
needsCodeEdit.where: frame function inside the first useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable or the shader fails to compile
Fills its parent, so the parent needs a defined width and height
Pointer and click listeners are attached to window, so interaction works even when other content sits above the canvas
Canvas is aria-hidden and decorative only
Click ping only works when clickEffect is 'ping'; any other value disables it
Pings last 4 seconds and the pointer follow is smoothed
Rendering stops when off screen, tab hidden or idle

options.look: Vertical lines with the sweep moving horizontally across the area
options.useWhen: Hero behind centered headline where a left-to-right sweep frames the text

options.look: Horizontal lines with the sweep moving vertically
options.useWhen: Wide banner or section divider where a top-to-bottom scan suits stacked content

options.look: Diagonal lines with the sweep running along 45 degrees
options.useWhen: Dynamic landing hero or product launch section that needs more energy
